derivation:
rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at h ⊢
exact (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hML) h
explanation: Mathlib proves that higher powers of any ideal are contained in lower powers. Instantiate it with the ideal generated by p; `Ideal.span_singleton_pow` identifies those ideal powers with the displayed principal ideals. The existing proof instead reduces membership to divisibility and uses `pow_dvd_pow`.
